name: Yu Gu
title: Professor; MMAE Academy of Distinguished Alumni Professor
department: Mechanical, Materials and Aerospace Engineering; Interactive Robotics Laboratory
fitReason: Substantial learned perception integrated with actual contact-rich agricultural robots, with newer physical model-identification work and a public exchange/visitor inquiry route.

physicalEvidence.summary: FloPE (March 2025 preprint; IROS 2025) distills perception into YOLOv11-nano and predicts flower poses, driving UR5 and six-arm StickBug visual-servoed contact. Physical tests use artificial bramble flowers, with success defined as tip-to-pistil contact, not biological fertilization. June 2026 branch work uses real UR5 interaction data to fit a FEM material model and guide deformation-aware manipulation; it is classical parameter estimation, not a new RL policy.

shortVisit.summary: Live official Join Us page has a dedicated Exchange/Visiting Position section inviting interested visitors to contact Gu. It was last modified May 16, 2021, so the currently visible inquiry route is dated and no 2027 capacity is established. The separate self-funded M.S. paragraph concerns pursuing a WVU degree, not permission for a self-funded external visit.

scoreReasons.fit: Strong perception-to-action agricultural robot methods; not primarily RL.
scoreReasons.physical: Two named lab robots physically execute learned-pose-guided contact; artificial-target limitation explicit.
scoreReasons.shortVisit: Live general exchange/visitor invitation, but old 2021 modification and no duration or external-master's eligibility stated.
scoreReasons.freshness: Explicit June 2026 physical robot/model-identification research and dated 2026 institutional activity establish recent research; the neural FloPE experiment remains correctly dated 2025.
